function.arguments:
{"path":"input.pqi","new_content":"SOLUTION 1
    temp 15
    units mmol/kgw
    C(-4) 5.0

GAS_PHASE 1
    -fixed_pressure
    -pressure 1.0
    -temperature 15
    CH4(g) 0

SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -solution true
    -density true
END
"}
